verse.verse_1: By oath of the fig and of the olive,
verse.verse_2: And by oath of Mount Sinai,
verse.verse_3: And by oath of this secure land,
verse.verse_4: We have indeed created man in the best shape.
verse.verse_5: We then turned him towards all the lowest of the low states.
verse.verse_6: Except those who accepted faith and did good deeds – for them is a never ending reward.
verse.verse_7: So after this, what causes you to deny the judgement?
verse.verse_8: Is not Allah the Greatest Judge upon all judges?
